brief: Queen Margaret was a descendant of Anglo-Saxon royalty that sought refuge during the Danish and Norman invasions of England. She was born in Hungary in 1046 and finally went to Scotland, where she married Malcolm III in 1070. She set about reforming the church in Scotland. Her husband, realising her ability, increasingly turned to her for advice. She was a devout and conscientious parent and famous for her care of orphans and poor people. She also established schools, hospitals and orphanages, and rebuilt the monastery of Iona. She died in 1093 and was buried at Dunfermline Abbey.
